cards.card_text: This is a psalm of David, Israel's king, written for remembrance.
cards.verse_text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance.
cards.snippet: A Psalm of David, for remembrance.

cards.card_text: He says it already existed in the ages before us, and there is no remembrance of those who came before.
cards.verse_text: There is no remembrance of those who came before, and those yet to come will not be remembered by those who follow after.
cards.snippet: There is no remembrance of those who came before, and those yet to come will not…

cards.card_text: The LORD hears them, and a scroll of remembrance is written before Him.
cards.verse_text: So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name.
cards.snippet: So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored…
